component.name: InfoMancer
component.summary: Self-hosted media catalog and library intelligence

description.p: InfoMancer catalogs, matches, inspects, and organizes movie and TV libraries from a native desktop workspace or an existing self-hosted InfoMancer server.
Beta 2 improves desktop stability, first-run setup, update handling, and Linux integration.

ul.li: Fixed desktop core cleanup when the application closes.
Improved guided setup and metadata credential management.
Improved Linux desktop identity, icons, and package metadata.
